navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the local tour-tender tier — Tintoreras (~1 nm), Playa del Amor, the airstrip transfer — all inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on protected lee water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: N35 Shuttle is the inter-island commuter platform — Isabela↔Santa Cruz (~50 nm) and Isabela↔San Cristóbal direct (~70 nm). Hybrid Quanta-LR remains the longer-horizon Galápagos↔mainland Ecuador trunk option.

precedents.why_it_matters: Isabela is the western leg of the same three-port triangle — paired build, not standalone.

regulatory_note: Same DPNG + Ministerio del Ambiente regime. Isabela has Galápagos National Park's strictest wildlife protection in the western archipelago — quiet-mode foiling is an excellent fit. UNESCO World Heritage marine reserve.
seasonality: Year-round operability; cool/dry season (June–November) brings stronger SE trades that foiling handles cleanly. Warm/wet season (December–May) is calmer and tourist-peak.

summary: Isabela is the largest island in the Galápagos with fast-growing tourism around Puerto Villamil. At ~50 nm from Santa Cruz it sits near the upper edge of the protected-water comfort band but is well inside Pioneer II / N35 Shuttle range. Completes the three-port triangle (Santa Cruz hub, San Cristóbal eastern, Isabela western) that defines the Galápagos commuter and tourist spine. Same UNESCO regulatory tailwind as Santa Cruz and San Cristóbal.
tagline: Largest Galápagos island with fast-growing tourism — completes the three-port triangle spine.
